# Extraction-seam corpus: the first 600 parts (sorted) carrying geometry in a
# colour other than 16/24, as enumerated by printed_ids() in
# scripts/sweep-marker-prims.py against the pinned LDraw tree.
#
# The full printed set is 11,220 parts, which is hours of wall clock. This
# slice yields 21,035 SVGs with 0 exceptions and 33 parts carrying no
# extractable decoration.
#
# It is NOT the same 600 the decal work reported against (11,855 SVGs) — that
# slice was not recorded, so this one is pinned here instead of re-enumerated,
# and an LDraw update cannot silently move it.
